name: pinterest-research
title_zh: 从 Pinterest 找选题到复盘落地页的本地免费
tagline_zh: 刷 Pinterest 刷不出选题、brief 写完没人审。
tagline_en: Turns endless Pinterest scrolling into ranked opportunities, original static and video briefs, reviewed exports.
desc_en: Research Pinterest opportunities for a brand, develop original static and video briefs, export reviewed experiments, and analyze Pinterest-to-website results using the local free workflow.
why_zh: 它把「找机会」和「看结果」接成闭环：brief 必须过评审才导出，导出的实验又能回填到站内转化数据上。
why_en: It closes the loop: briefs must pass review before export, and exported experiments feed back into site conversion data instead.
limit_zh: 只跑本地免费流程，不接付费 API 也不代你发布；Pinterest 到官网的归因依赖你自己埋点或 UTM。
limit_en: Local free workflow only: no paid APIs, no auto-publishing. Pinterest-to-site attribution needs your own tracking or UTMs; without them you only see.
title_en: Local free pipeline from Pinterest research to.
